Woman Dies After Blackmail Over Fake Rare Coins, AI Video

A woman died by suicide after allegedly being blackmailed using an AI-generated video and a scam involving fake rare coins. Six individuals have been arrested in connection with the case. The incident occurred in Rajasthan, and the arrests were made from Bihar.
